description:
This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Injector_AutoParagraph, which is a PHP class responsible for automatically inserting

tags based on double-spacing in a HTML document. It contains methods for handling text and element tokens, splitting text into paragraphs, and determining when to insert paragraph tags.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_AutoParagraph
classes.description:
A class that extends HTMLPurifier_Injector to automatically wrap text separated by double newlines with

tags, ensuring proper paragraph structuring in HTML content.

methods.name: _pStart
methods.description:
Creates and returns a new start token for a

element with error handling for well-formedness.

methods.name: handleText
methods.description:
Processes text tokens to determine if and where

tags should be inserted based on double newlines.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description:
Processes element tokens to insert

tags appropriately based on inline or block context.

methods.name: _splitText
methods.description: Splits text data into separate paragraph tokens based on double newline delimiters and manages start/end paragraph situations.

methods.name: _isInline
methods.description: Determines if a token is inline element permitted within paragraph tags.

methods.name: _pLookAhead
methods.description:
Peeks ahead in token stream to decide if a

tag should be inserted.

methods.name: _checkNeedsP
methods.description:
Checks if a given token requires a

tag to be inserted before it.
